items.t: Water on the driver's floor from a clogged A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C drain and install bulletin drain fix; dry carpet
items.note: Owners report $400 to $1,200. A simple drain clean costs far less than repairs that need the dash removed.

items.t: Fuel filler pipe rusts and leaks (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel filler pipe
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Automatic transmission flares or shifts harshly
items.job: Diagnose and repair or rebuild automatic transmission
items.note: Fluid service and diagnosis are cheap. Owners report about $1,200 for shift-related repairs; a full rebuild or replacement costs more.

items.t: Check engine light from vacuum leaks
items.job: Smoke test and replace leaking vacuum hose or gasket

items.t: Rear subframe rusts and suspension arm breaks loose
items.job: Replace rear subframe or rusted control arms and mounts
items.note: Price depends on how much is rusted; a used subframe lowers the parts cost.

items.t: Key comes out when shifter isn't in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct ignition key interlock
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Fuel tank strap bracket can split (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinforce fuel tank strap bracket
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Defroster airflow switches on its own (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair HVAC mode door shaft
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Passenger seat belt anchor can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger seat belt and bracket
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Seat side airbag bracket badly welded (recall)
items.job: Inspect seat airbag bracket weld; replace seatback if needed
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Parking brake cable nut can loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten parking brake cable lock nut
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Driver seat riser can crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace driver seat riser bracket
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: Dealer trailer wiring module can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace trailer hitch wiring harness and module
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if it was never done. Check your VIN for open recalls.

items.t: High-pitched whine from the drivetrain
items.job: Repair transfer case or differential causing whine
items.note: Owners report an average of about $1,600.

items.t: Rear or side window glass shatters by itself
items.job: Replace side or liftgate glass
items.note: Owners report about $400.

items.t: Rear power window falls into the door
items.job: Replace rear window regulator
items.note: An out-of-warranty quote reported by an owner was about $250 before tax.

items.t: Interior flooding from blocked body drains
items.job: Clear body and sunroof drains; dry and clean interior
items.note: Owners report up to about $1,500 when carpet and padding must be replaced.

items.t: Clogged catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: Owners report about $1,200.

items.t: Timing belt failure
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler
items.note: RepairPal lists a timing belt tensioner job at $555–$703. Many shops also replace the water pump at the same time.

items.t: Failed ignition coil causes rough running
items.job: Replace ignition coil
items.note: Rear-bank coils take longer to reach.

items.t: Airbag (SRS) warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose SRS fault and replace failed sensor or module
items.note: RepairPal lists an airbag clockspring at about $319–$353; other sensors vary.

items.t: Exterior door handles snap off
items.job: Replace exterior door handle

items.t: Sunroof wind noise
items.job: Adjust sunroof glass and replace seal

items.t: Black paint fades and peels
items.job: Repaint affected panels
items.note: Cost depends on how many panels need paint.

items.t: Tire pressure warning light flashes
items.job: Replace TPMS sensor and relearn
